trans-unit.source: This whole island's about as dark as dark gets...
trans-unit.target: This whole island's about as dark as dark gets...

trans-unit.source: It is very likely that the darkness is the handiwork of Dhaos.
trans-unit.target: It is very likely that the darkness is the handiwork of Dhaos.

trans-unit.source: Then the castle seen at the mine ruins... Could it really be...?
trans-unit.target: Then the castle seen at the mine ruins... Could it really be...?

trans-unit.source: I'm all but convinced it's Dhaos' at this point.
trans-unit.target: I'm all but convinced it's Dhaos' at this point.

trans-unit.source: Why don't we go bust its doors down?
